quarterly_data.quarter: Sanyo Denki semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half FY2026 (April - September 2025, semi-annual report): consolidated revenue JPY 50,784 million (+9.2% YoY), operating profit JPY 4,848 million (+59.1%), profit before tax JPY 4,937 million (+91.7%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 3,509 million (+119.3%); orders received JPY 53,408 million (+31.6%), order backlog JPY 38,506 million (+0.3%). Management states demand from its main factory-automation markets (communication equipment, robots, semiconductor manufacturing equipment) was still recovering, but the AI-related market was robust and the order backlog rose overall.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 50,784 million (+9.2%); operating profit JPY 4,848 million (+59.1%); orders JPY 53,408 million (+31.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanyo Denki semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: San Ace Company (cooling fans), first half FY2026: management states demand for San Ace from AI servers and network equipment was strong and distributor business in North America and Japan was robust, while servo amplifier, inverter, robot and general machine-tool demand was still recovering; the US market was active and Europe was sluggish. Segment revenue JPY 20,304 million (+12.3%), segment profit JPY 3,845 million (+30.9%), orders JPY 18,587 million (+27.3%), order backlog JPY 10,852 million (-27.1%).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 San Ace revenue JPY 20,304 million (+12.3%); orders JPY 18,587 million (+27.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanyo Denki semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics and Motion Companies, first half FY2026: SANUPS demand from renewable energy was stable and social-infrastructure demand (national resilience, railways) turned up, but demand for machinery including semiconductor manufacturing equipment was slow to recover; SANMOTION demand for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and wafer transfer robots was firm on AI-related capex but overall had not returned to previous levels. Electronics Company revenue JPY 10,300 million (+3.7%), orders JPY 11,393 million (+30.6%); Motion Company revenue JPY 17,587 million (+10.2%), segment profit JPY 745 million (prior-year segment loss JPY 11 million), orders JPY 20,723 million (+43.9%), backlog JPY 14,823 million (+31.7%). First-half North America revenue JPY 11,418 million (JPY 9,105 million a year earlier).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 Motion revenue JPY 17,587 million (+10.2%); Motion orders JPY 20,723 million (+43.9%)
